{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=4|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==

* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] (canned is fine)
* 4 cups [[cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|ground white pepper]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|granulated garlic]]
* ⅛ tsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne]]

==Procedure==

# In a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], working in batches if necessary, [[Cookbook:Puree|puree]] tomatoes, cream, sugar, pepper, salt, garlic and cayenne.
# Transfer soup to a [[Cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]] and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]] over high heat.
# Reduce heat and [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]], stirring occasionally, until soup thickens, 20–30 minutes.
# Serve hot.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Try [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnishing]] soup with cooked [[Cookbook:shrimp|shrimp]] or slices of [[Cookbook:sausage|andouille sausage]].
